描述_EN: the cup is similarly decorated on the outside, except that the ladies are standing individually and holding floral sprays. the mark on the base of the cup reads qiyu tang zhi (made by the hall of rare jade). a border of geometrical pattern embellishes the rim. a floral spray is placed between each pair of ladies. other marks consisting of the words qiyu (rare jade) are qiyu meizhi (beautifully made like a rare jade) and qiyu baoding zhizhen (rare jade valuable as a precious tripod). the former appears on a saucer in the v&a (c.1349-1924), and the latter on a pair of bowls (c.927&928-1910) and a pair of vases (c.854&855-1910), all painted with figures in underglaze blue and dating to the kangxi period. four cups of similar size and decoration are in the flagstaff house museum of tea ware, hong kong, three of which carry the qiyu tang zhi mark and one with the character xing (prosperous). small cup and saucer of egg-shell porcelain decorated in underglaze blue. a saucer with the qiyu tang zhi mark, and similar in size to the v&a saucer, went as far as the middle east and is now in the topkapi saray museum in istanbul. hence qiyu tang was probably the name of a kiln that specialised in porcelain decorated with figures. on the base of the saucer is the character qing (to celebrate) within a double circle. on the inside of the saucer is a central panel enclosing a lady seated on a mat on a terrace, around which are arranged four pairs of ladies seated back to back, painted in two tones of blue. on the outside are two pearls and two pictures adorned with ribbons.
描述_ZN: 杯的外壁也有类似的装饰，只是女士们各自站立，手持花束。 杯底的标记是 "奇玉堂制"。 边缘有几何图案的边框点缀。 每对女士之间都有一朵花。 其他由 "奇玉 "组成的标记有 "奇玉美器 "和 "奇玉宝鼎"。 前者出现在V&A（约1349-1924）的一个碟子上，后者出现在一对碗（约927&928-1910）和一对花瓶（约854&855-1910）上，都是釉里红的人物，可追溯到康熙时期。 香港旗杆屋茶具博物馆藏有四只类似尺寸和装饰的杯子，其中三只带有 "启玉堂 "的标记，一只带有 "兴 "字。 小杯和蛋壳瓷碟，以釉下青花装饰。 一个带有 "齐玉堂之 "标记的碟子，与V&A碟子的大小相似，远赴中东，现存于伊斯坦布尔的Topkapi Saray博物馆。 因此，齐玉堂可能是一个专门生产人物装饰瓷器的窑场名称。 在碟子的底部有一个双圆内的 "庆 "字。 在碟子的内侧是一个中央面板，围着一个坐在露台的垫子上的女士，周围排列着四对背靠背坐着的女士，用两种蓝色的色调绘制。 在外面有两颗珍珠和两幅用丝带装饰的画。
